# zabbix_hostgroup (Resource)

Manages a Zabbix host group. Hosts must belong to at least one, and permissions are granted per group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zabbix_hostgroup" "linux_servers" {
  name = "Linux servers/production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Host group name. Zabbix treats "/" as a nesting separator, e.g. "Linux servers/production"

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

```shell
# Zabbix objects are imported by their numeric id, which the frontend shows
# in the URL of the object's configuration form.
terraform import zabbix_hostgroup.linux_servers 42
```
